crusadecraft.warmap.title: War map
crusadecraft.warmap.open.tip: Lay down the war map: the battle plan of your realm and your allies, and the sieges under way. Your ruler draws it right here.
crusadecraft.warmap.leave.tip: Put the war map away and go back to the political map.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.offensive.tip: Paint an offensive zone, chunk by chunk: where you will attack.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.defense.tip: Paint a defence zone: what must be held.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.erase.tip: Erase the painted zones under the brush.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.arrow.tip: Draw an attack arrow: click at the start, drag to the end, release.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.pin.tip: Place an annotated marker: objective, rally point, danger or a plain note.
crusadecraft.warmap.tool.remove.tip: Remove one of your arrows or markers: click on it.
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.offensive: Hold left click: paint · right click: move · wheel: zoom
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.defense: Hold left click: paint · right click: move · wheel: zoom
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.objective: Hold left click: paint · right click: move · wheel: zoom
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.erase: Hold left click: erase · right click: move · wheel: zoom
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.arrow: Click at the start and drag to the end · right click: move
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.pin: Click where to place the marker · drag: move the map
crusadecraft.warmap.hint.remove: Click on one of your arrows or markers
crusadecraft.warmap.clear.tip: Erase your whole plan, in every dimension. A second click confirms.
crusadecraft.warmap.too_big: Too many chunks at once: %s at most.
crusadecraft.warmap.full: Your plan is full: %s at most of this kind.
crusadecraft.warmap.arrow.short: Arrow too short: drag it over at least one chunk.
crusadecraft.warmap.arrow.drag: Hold the click and drag to draw an arrow.
crusadecraft.warmap.pin.title: Place a marker
crusadecraft.warmap.not_yours: That is not in your plan.
crusadecraft.warmap.remove.none: Nothing of your plan here: aim at one of your arrows or markers.
crusadecraft.codex.cartedeguerre.p0: On the realm map (comma key), the $(l)⚔ War$() button lays down your realm's battle plan. Paint $(l)offensive$(), $(l)defence$() and $(l)objective$() zones chunk by chunk, draw attack $(l)arrows$(), place annotated $(l)markers$().
crusadecraft.codex.cartedeguerre.p1: Only the ruler draws the plan; their allies, suzerain and vassals see it on their own map, and they see theirs. Sieges under way appear by themselves, with the garrison still holding.$(br2)On Dynmap, the $(l)War map$() layer shows all of this to anyone who has the web map address.
